purpose: Accelerate broad source discovery without weakening publication, identity or reuse constraints.

preferred.interpretation: Preserve high-res colour original as technically acquired research-only; no artist, crop, liturgy or rights approval.

borderline.interpretation: Retain borderline authentic painting source only in research artifact and contact sheet; do not credit as a target-minimum original or automatically publish.

rejectBelow.interpretation: Reject insufficient display resolution or nearly monochrome source for this artwork acquisition lane.

autoAcquire: Museum-classified painting with original image and object-level CC0 or equivalent source metadata.
manualReview: Traditional painted panel icons with exact iconography and reproduction rights.
Frescoes and mural paintings when original photograph is eligible for worldwide commercial app reuse.
Historic altarpieces and coherent painted cycles where source reproduction is legally cleared.
neverAutoApprove: Photographs of sculptures, museum installations or tourist objects.
Line engravings or prints disguised as full-colour paintings.
Modern copyrighted photos of old artworks without reproduction rights.
AI-generated paintings passed off as historical originals.
Subject inferred only from vague theological resemblance or calendar date.

metricGrades.A: Artwork specifically depicts observed subject / scripturally appointed event with source evidence.
metricGrades.B: Observed day has a defensible relevant contextual religious image, qualified as context and not exact.
metricGrades.C: Only thematic or uncertain leads; not a covered day.
